name: Trinket

effects.name: Craftable (hidden)
effects.tooltip: Craftable : This item can be enhanced via Essence Crafting .

flavor_text: A small trinket capable of being imbued with magical effects.
tips: Gem of Many Facets (or its epic and legendary version) is strictly superior to plain trinket. It comes with a Yellow augment slot and is part of named item sets. It is not possible to apply shards with effects until you disjunct the item ( DDO Forums ARCHIVE ME! ) Craftable trinket from the DDO Store is BtA ( DDO Forums ARCHIVE ME! ). You can turn the item into BtA version by applying a BtA shard.
